symptom: An execution integration test could admit a source proof before the initial login listener was ready; its onReady invalidation then made the same admission fail transiently with executionUnavailable.
rule: zstack-review and principles 4 and 14 require fixtures to await their real startup boundary. Hold the LISTEN reply to prove admission cannot race its initial invalidation, without adding retries or timing sleeps.
check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/cloud/execution/person-compatibility.integration.test.ts -t 'initial source-invalidation listener'
